last.verdict: PENN's online losses shrank sharply and casinos grew, lifting profit to $284 million and cutting debt; the full-year online target stands.

takeaways.label: Online losses shrink
takeaways.text: The online segment lost $18.3 million before interest, taxes and similar items, versus $76.6 million a year ago. Revenue rose to $348.4 million, and management reiterated its full-year profit target for it.

takeaways.label: Casinos keep growing
takeaways.text: Casino revenue hit a third-quarter record near $1.5 billion. Profit before rent was $501.8 million at a 33.7% margin, the third straight quarter of improving margins. October stayed healthy.

takeaways.label: Profit and debt
takeaways.text: Company-wide adjusted profit rose to $284.0 million from $194.9 million. Net debt fell to $1.8 billion from $2.2 billion at year-end, with $1.0 billion in cash.

history.verdict: Record casino results and a smaller digital loss won modest approval.

reasons.label: Record casino quarter
reasons.text: Retail revenue hit a record $1.5 billion; nine properties set Q2 records, and July trends stayed strong.

reasons.label: Digital losses shrinking
reasons.text: Interactive lost $9.5 million versus $62.0 million a year ago; iCasino revenue hit a record.

reasons.label: Profit jump, debt falling
reasons.text: Adjusted EBITDA rose to $312.6 million from $236.1 million; net debt fell to $1.9 billion.
